solution_fitted_on.what: solved game model (components plus count, mode and coach tables)

dynamic_kickoff_2024.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

dynamic_kickoff_2025.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

solution_fitted_on.note: the only test-season content is the components' kickoff rule tables; the solved game uses the latest rule's table for every kickoff

out_of_sample_note: every table of the solved game is fitted on development seasons (2010 to 2023); the play-outcome models likewise, except the kickoff rule tables (the 2025 rule's table is used for every simulated kickoff). The test-season comparison is therefore out of sample.
policy_note: coach = fourth downs sampled from observed coach behavior by situation (development seasons), measured timeout rates, simple end-of-half kicking rules; optimal = the solved policy of the game model
real_data: out of sample: seasons 2024 to 2025 (test, via splits.load_test_plays); in sample: 2021 to 2023 (development)
